challenges.says: The criterion about rebuilding a registry-backed source from the three policy locations cites no rule although it is the second half of businessrule-62577216252619197563 (which another criterion cites for only the policy-file half), so it is uncited without saying why.
The Escape criterion cites no rule and does not say it rests only on the action block that closes the dialog as cancelled; 'nothing is written' is an inference the action does not state.

The value-format criterion for the product owner is written in code terms ('dword:', 'hex(n)', 'column 78', trailing backslash, hex bytes) that a person who never saw the code could not follow, and it packs several rules' worth of detail into one sentence.
